correctness.rationale: The explicit x-independent distributional contact solution reduces the PDE to two transports. Direct measure of their finite-face supports gives each length vt and overlap (2vt-L)_+, and integration proves the universal closed formula. The mixed-difference zero condition for all state rectangles is equivalent to vanishing mixed derivative and additive separability on a connected domain. The product-flux system is symmetrizable and strictly hyperbolic for positive states; its squared Courant bound 2349/2500<1 and rational flux discrepancy 16/1000 are exact. The extracted checker independently confirms 10,500 rational integrations but is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Independent vertex flux additions are a natural component of approximate multidimensional Riemann/finite-volume schemes. The exact interaction onset at tangential CFL 1/2 and missing squared-hinge finite-face flux identify a sharp structural boundary with a globally sub-CFL-one strictly hyperbolic example. The if-and-only-if additive-flux criterion separates safe superposition from genuine nonlinear two-corner interaction. This is a precise benchmark for high-Courant flux reconstruction, not a generic instability claim or arbitrary small numerical gain.
